tooling.message:
docs(plan): evals focus on following the process; first results and next step

## Intent

An app the agent built by the guidance is good when its creator knows the subject. The evals should therefore measure how well the agent follows the process, not the quality of the content.

## Key changes

- Step 10 of the plan records the focus: the evals measure how the agent follows the process; content quality is not scored.
- It links the first results (33 runs, three archetypes with Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5) at lernapps.net/tooling/evals/.
- Next: optimise the guidance for agents (compact, bullets, less boilerplate) and compare quality and cost.

moved.why: Records the focus asked for here. Its joinsWith commit 9a930cf (a test timeout) serves the merge of the eval branch and is in i130, so it stays its own commit.
